name: gali
description: GALI monorepo root. Frontend is in packages/web. Python packages (core/api/pipeline) are managed separately via pip, see .venv.

scripts.build: cd packages/web && npm install && npm run build && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.cpSync('.next', '../.next', {recursive: true}); if (fs.existsSync('public')) fs.cpSync('public', '../public', {recursive: true});"
scripts.vercel-build: cd packages/web && npm install && npm run build && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.cpSync('.next', '../.next', {recursive: true}); if (fs.existsSync('public')) fs.cpSync('public', '../public', {recursive: true});"
